name: lnkk-links
description: Lnkk.it Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for conversational link shortening, Smart App Opener mobile deep-linking, vector QR codes, custom domains, and analytics.
subtitle: Smart Links & Vector QR

interface.subtitle: Smart Links & Vector QR
interface.longDescription: Lnkk.it Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for conversational link shortening, Smart App Opener mobile deep-linking (YouTube, Spotify, Amazon, Instagram), customizable vector SVG/PNG QR codes, custom branded domain verification, and real-time click analytics directly from ChatGPT.

interface.subtitle: Smart Links & Vector QR
interface.longDescription: Lnkk.it Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for conversational link shortening, Smart App Opener mobile deep-linking (YouTube, Spotify, Amazon, Instagram), customizable vector SVG/PNG QR codes, custom branded domain verification, and real-time click analytics directly from ChatGPT.

positive.description: Shorten destination URL with Smart App Opener mobile deep-linking
positive.prompt: Shorten https://youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ with Smart App Opener enabled
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a trackable short link with Smart App Opener mobile breakout enabled and returns the shortened link.

positive.description: Generate high-resolution vector SVG QR code with custom brand styling
positive.prompt: Generate a vector SVG QR code for https://www.lnkk.it with brand color #7C3AED
positive.expected_behavior: Generates a high-resolution vector SVG QR code styled with the purple brand color and returns the SVG data.

positive.description: Inspect custom domain DNS configuration and verify CNAME resolution
positive.prompt: Check DNS setup and CNAME records for domain links.mybrand.com
positive.expected_behavior: Checks DNS resolution for the custom domain and confirms whether CNAME correctly points to custom.lnkk.it.

positive.description: Pre-flight security scan of destination URL for malware and phishing
positive.prompt: Scan destination URL https://example.com for malware and phishing safety
positive.expected_behavior: Scans destination URL headers and security indicators to verify safety and reports 0 malicious threats.

positive.description: Retrieve comprehensive click metrics and geographic breakdown
positive.prompt: Show link click analytics and country breakdown for my top links
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieves aggregate account analytics including total clicks, referrers, devices, and country breakdown.

negative.description: General programming query that should be handled natively without triggering link tools
negative.prompt: Write a python script to calculate Fibonacci numbers up to 100
negative.expected_behavior: The model should answer natively with python code and should not invoke any Lnkk.it tools.

negative.description: Travel booking query completely unrelated to links or QR codes
negative.prompt: Book a one-way flight from New York to London for next Tuesday
negative.expected_behavior: The model should answer the travel query or ask for flight details without invoking any Lnkk.it tools.

negative.description: Natural language translation task that should not invoke link tools
negative.prompt: Translate this French paragraph into Spanish: Bonjour le monde, comment allez-vous aujourd'hui?
negative.expected_behavior: The model should translate the sentence directly without invoking any Lnkk.it tools.
